doc: Read the air's cells and wind, apply a quantity at a place, step it, return to a frame, ask what would be, and why a cell is what it is.

tools.name: air.observe
tools.description: The frame, the state's hash, the cells and parked blocks, the strongest wind, and each channel over the field: its unit, least, most and total, and where its most is

budget.description: the most bytes of answer: channels are left out from the last, and `more` says how many

tools.name: air.at
tools.description: The air at a place: the cell there (none outside the cells), each channel in its unit, how warm in kelvin, and the wind

tools.name: air.set
tools.description: A quantity applied to the cell at a place at the start of the next step — once, or held there every step until the next air.set of that cell and channel (a fire that keeps burning)
tools.undo: air.seek to the frame before it took effect

then.why: step the air: what is applied acts from the next step

at.description: [x, y, z] in metres: a cell must be there

channel.description: a channel of the program (temperature, wetness, charge …)

hold.description: a boolean (its id): applied every step, not once (false lets a held one go)

tools.name: air.step
tools.description: Steps the air: what is applied, then the laws across the cells, then the wind moved and the heat carried
tools.undo: air.seek to the frame it began at

steps.description: how many (1 when none is given)

tools.name: air.seek
tools.description: Returns to a frame within the history kept; what is stepped from there is a new branch, and what was held is let go
tools.undo: none within the air: what came after the frame is another branch's

then.why: read the air at the frame returned to

tools.name: air.branch
tools.description: What would be: the air some steps ahead with what is held and, if given, one more quantity applied, observed as air.observe does; the air itself untouched

steps.description: how far ahead (1 when none is given)

set.description: {at, channel, value, hold?}: as air.set, in the branch alone

tools.name: air.explain
tools.description: Why the cell at a place is what it is after the last step: each law that held, what flowed in and out by which law from which neighbour (its place), what it read, and the material it became by, if it did

tasks.name: see-the-air
tasks.summary: Read the field as a whole and the air at one place

tasks.name: light-a-fire
tasks.summary: Hold a cell hot, step, and read the updraft and why the cell above is warm

tasks.name: ask-before-heating
tasks.summary: See what a fire would do some steps ahead, the air itself untouched
